rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: TODAY, 10:00am ET: the SEC's three-member commission (Atkins, Peirce, Uyeda) votes at an open meeting on whether to publish 'Regulation Crypto' — a ~400-page proposal with a startup exemption (~$5M via whitepaper disclosure, 4-year runway), a $75M/12-month fundraising exemption, and, critically, an investment-contract SAFE HARBOR letting tokens exit securities classification once their networks are sufficiently decentralized. That relief accrues almost entirely to ALTCOINS, not BTC — BTC was never the securities question. TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg called it 'a pivotal rulemaking.' Stacking on top: Solana's Agave v4.2 targets MAINNET ACTIVATION the week of Aug 17 (Monday), starting the phased slot-time cut toward 200ms and enabling the Alpenglow consensus overhaul (finality 12.8s -> 150ms; on-chain vote costs eliminated, dropping minimum profitable validator stake to ~450 SOL). SOL ETFs also logged $8.8M of inflows on Aug 10, the strongest day since May 12, lifting net assets to ~$906M. Canonical dashboard proxy FRESH this run (asOf 2026-08-14T13:18:29Z): SOL 75.24, BTC 62594.23, ETH 1866.88, XRP 1.0008, LINK 8.795, AVAX 6.37, ADA 0.17922.
positions.driver: NOTE: the Aug 13 run did not fire, so SOL was held two days rather than one. Closed SOL at 75.24 (canonical live) vs entry 76.78 for -213.40 (-2.01%) — a soft, broadly risk-off tape, not a SOL-specific break. ROLLED BACK INTO SOL as today's best risk-adjusted pick. Wins vs runners-up on the merits: BTC (62594.23) is the nominal 'protection' pick but it is the one asset the SEC proposal does NOT help, its ETF flows flipped negative (-$144.6M on Aug 10, snapping a 7-day positive streak), and it has now lost the $63k handle — over the last two days BTC fell -2.46% vs SOL's -2.01%, i.e. the safe pick was not actually safer. ETH (1866.88) remains the laggard with no dated catalyst. XRP (1.0008) is sitting on round-number support but has no fresh trigger and has been underperforming. LINK/AVAX/ADA are higher-risk with nothing dated. SOL is the only name in the liquid universe stacking TWO dated catalysts inside 72 hours — the SEC alt-favorable vote today and Agave v4.2 mainnet activation Monday — with returning ETF bid and demonstrated relative strength through the drawdown. That is the asymmetry: capped, definable downside at the -10% stop against two live upside triggers.
positions.risks: The vote only opens the proposal for PUBLIC COMMENT — it is not a final rule and it is well-telegraphed, so classic sell-the-news is the single biggest risk; a delay or a contentious dissent would hit alts hardest. The tape is genuinely risk-off: BTC dominance 56.5%, Altcoin Season Index sub-50, BTC ETF flows negative — capital is hiding in BTC and a further BTC leg down drags SOL harder (higher beta). Agave v4.2 is a PHASED activation and the full 'Alpenswitch' to Alpenglow is not until late Q3/early Q4, so any slippage in the Aug 17 window removes the second leg of the thesis. Loss of ~$74 opens a slide to $72 and the low-$70s. Hard stop 67.72 (-10%).
